messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: AUTOPAGE fired: prometheus.scrape_failure_count spike in prod (x148 spikes in 5m). PagerDuty PD000123 created and routed to eng-sre-oncall. Investigate asap.

alex: Acked PD000123. looking now — which scrape job? any exporter name?

incident-bot: Scrape target: prometheus-exporter/payment-metrics (eu-prod), error: tls handshake timeout, 502s. Kafka ingest lag rising for log-ingest topic. Customers: some dashboard panels stale; replication lag warning. See alert payload: https://alerts.internal/pd/PD000123

riley: I can take triage. quick checks: kube events, exporter pods, scraper-proxy, and kafka consumer lag. moving to #eng-sre-call if we need voice.

alex: quick kubectl logs showed exporter OOMs earlier, then restart loop. output:
```
E0321 10:12:03 exporter.go:212] runtime: out of memory
panic: runtime: out of memory
```
Pod: payment-exporter-7f9b8 (eu-prod)

morgan: kafka consumer lag for log-ingest-consumer-group: 230k msgs, consumer count 2. trend up. ingestion-write throughput dropped ~40%.

riley: ok — two parallel mitigation paths: (1) prevent PD storm (suppress dup pages), (2) reduce customer impact by routing scrapes to fallback exporter or region, (3) address log backpressure (scale consumers / add temporary downstream capacity).

alex: suppressing further autopages for this alert class for 10m while we triage — pd suppression in place. @opsbot can you confirm suppression applied?

opsbot: suppression applied: alert: prometheus.scrape_failure_count (label: job=payment-exporter), duration 10m. All further autopages for this rule suppressed for 10 minutes. (reaction :white_check_mark:)

riley: triage findings: exporter OOM due to recent metrics label cardinality spike after release 1.12. rollback of release might help but risky. Suggest quick restart with increased memory limit and temp sampling to drop high-card labels.

sam: if we bump memory and restart exporter, we're likely to catch up metrics but logs still backlog. propose: 1) scale exporter replica to 3 (horizontal pod autoscaler temporarily), 2) update resource requests to 1.5Gi, 3) scale kafka consumer group to 4. I can run commands with ops approval.

alex: run the commands. paste exact kubectl cmds here please.

sam: on it:
```
# scale exporter
kubectl scale deploy/payment-exporter --replicas=3 -n prod
# patch resource
kubectl patch deployment payment-exporter -n prod --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"payment-exporter","resources":{"requests":{"memory":"1500Mi"},"limits":{"memory":"2Gi"}}}]}}}}'
# scale consumers (k8s or keda)
kubectl scale deploy/log-ingest-consumer --replicas=4 -n prod
```

morgan: running kafka consumer rebalance now. consumer groups showing decreasing lag: 230k -> 54k in 6m after scale.

riley: restarting exporter pods one-by-one to avoid thundering herd. watch metrics for label explosion. also bounce scrape-proxy to pick up new endpoints.

alex: note — product dashboards still show stale panels for ~10 customers. product-oncall: can you notify impacted stakeholders and put a banner? link to status page recommended.

product-oncall: putting banner on status.redwood.com and emailing top-affected accounts. drafting message now.

incident-bot: PagerDuty PD000123: incident acknowledged by alex; status: mitigation in progress. Related alerts: PD000124 (log-ingest-lag) auto-created.

riley: consumer scale looks good. exporter restarts succeeded, no OOMs in latest logs. sample logs:
```
I0321 10:24:12 exporter.go:98] started scrape loop
I0321 10:24:48 exporter.go:270] collected 370 metrics
```

morgan: log-ingest backlog decreased to 12k. ingestion throughput back to 92% of normal. dashboards refreshing for most customers.

alex: preparing handoff — I'll rotate out in 20m. riley, do you want to take to completion and own postmortem?

riley: yep, I'll run the post-incident review. action items so far: (1) revert release changes increasing cardinality OR add sampling (owner: product), (2) increase exporter memory and set HPA (owner: eng-runtime), (3) add alert to detect sudden metric cardinality rises (owner: eng-ml). I'll create tasks.

sam: filing runbook updates: add exporter restart checklist and consumer-scale play. tagging oncall runbook.

opsbot: PD000123: note added: "mitigation: scaled exporter, increased memory, scaled consumers, suppressed duplicate pages." Resolved? Pending verification for 15m.

alex: leaving note and handoff: riley takes over. I'm OOO for next window. (reaction :wave:)

riley: ack. I'll monitor for next 30m and then close. if things look stable, we'll resolve PD000123 and PD000124 and open postmortem doc: https://docs.internal/incidents/PD000123

incident-bot: PD000123 resolved by riley at 1765440148. Autopage suppression lifted. Incident duration ~13m. Severity: sev2. Postmortem assigned to riley + sam + product-oncall.

morgan: quick note — add a follow-up to look at scrape-proxy timeout config (currently 10s) — maybe bump to 20s for flaky endpoints.

riley: added. closing thread and will kick off postmortem later today. thanks all for quick responses. :v:
